preparation.scope: Adoption from pinned verified research intermediates, display property normalization, and deterministic gzip. Upstream extraction and geometry preparation are separately documented. Large source archives and monthly ranges are not bundled.
preparation.geometryPolicy: Drainage uses the separately validated shared-edge simplification. Both groundwater datasets retain all source geometry coordinates unchanged. Seven invalid national polygons remain in the asset and must receive no fill.

source.product: Canadian Gridded Homogenized Monthly Precipitation – Version 2 (CanGridP mlyV2)
source.format: NetCDF classic CDF1; CF-1.6 declaration; float64 precipitation
source.geographicCoordinates: Source 2D lat/lon float64 arrays, both dimensions [x,y]; use these arrays for registration.
source.sourceXYWarning: The x/y variables contain integer grid indices but have degree units. Do not interpret x/y as geographic longitude/latitude.
source.documentedProjection: Polar stereographic, true at 60 degrees north, centered on 110 degrees west, approximately 10 km resolution. The catalogue calls the grid EASE; do not claim strict equal-area or invent an EPSG code.
source.landVariable: land; 1 land, 0 nonland; 100945 land cells out of 291870 rectangular cells
source.landMaskWarning: In the inspected January 1991 record, all 291870 precipitation values are numerically valid, including 190925 nonland cells. Mask land!=1 explicitly; _FillValue alone does not mask oceans.
source.quantity: Monthly total precipitation in millimeters; liquid precipitation plus frozen precipitation water equivalent. Spatially interpolated adjusted and homogenized station series, not station measurements at each grid point.
source.derivation: Average each calendar month across 30 years only when all 30 monthly totals are finite, nonnegative, and unequal to -999. Sum all 12 complete monthly averages and retain only land==1. Missing data remain missing.
source.primaryFigure: Supplementary Figure S2.3: 1961–1990 and 1991–2020 average annual precipitation amounts (mm), based on CanGridP mlyV2.
source.reuse: Copy, modify, publish, translate, adapt and distribute are allowed, including commercially, subject to source attribution and a licence link where possible. Do not imply government endorsement.
source.attribution: Source: Environment and Climate Change Canada, CanGridP mlyV2. Annual 1991–2020 averages calculated from monthly gridded total precipitation. Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada.
source.distinctionFromPublishedNormals: The separately published CanGridP_Norm_mlyV2.nc covers 1961–1990, not 1991–2020. This deliverable derives modern annual normals from the published monthly series; do not call it an original ECCC 1991–2020 normals file.
source.readmeMismatch: ReadMe references land_mask and grid_area, but the actual NetCDF variable names are land and grid area; use the actual inspected names.
source.regionalAveraging: Use supplied grid area values in square kilometers as weights; an unweighted national average is not appropriate.
source.rendering: Source land/missing masks must be preserved. Parent should clip coarse cell footprints to its trustworthy Canada outline. Do not extrapolate into missing or nonland cells.
source.observedCoverageStatus: Final valid and missing land counts, northern counts, extrema and hashes are recorded in annual-precipitation-summary.json after extraction completes.

summary.definition: Mean annual total precipitation: rain plus frozen precipitation water equivalent; interpolated adjusted and homogenized station data, not individual station observations.
summary.method: Mean each calendar month across all30 years, requiring all30 values finite, nonnegative and different from source fill -999; annual total is sum of12 valid monthlymeans; retain only source land==1.
summary.documentedProjection: Polar stereographic, true at60N, central meridian110W; readme describes approximately10km resolution. Geolocation supplied by 2D latitude/longitude.
summary.warning: Precipitation values exist outside land. Apply source land mask before plotting. Do not turn nonland values into coverage; no fabricated fill. Use provided geolocation, not x/y variable misleading degree units. Regional averages require grid-area weighting.

rendering.targetCRS: EPSG:4326 equirectangular affine locator, y decreasing with latitude
rendering.imageFit: Draw full image at x=0,y=0,width=900,height=580, preserveAspectRatio=none; coordinate extent matches parent exactly.
rendering.nativeResolution: Approximately10km; rendering does not increase scientific resolution.
rendering.resampling: Categorical source-cell footprint painting; no interpolated or fabricated precipitation values. Pixel alpha0 outside valid source land cells.
rendering.clipRequirement: Apply the existing trustworthy Canadian outline clip in parent SVG/canvas. Source land mask is preserved, but no additional national outline was available to this script.

precipitation.pointTablePrecision: Source table rounds longitude/latitude to 4 decimals and annual mm to 1 decimal; it is an audit/download table, not the raster render input.
precipitation.scientificResolution: Approximately 10 km source grid; image pixels do not increase resolution.
precipitation.nationalClipRequirement: Clip raster to the existing trustworthy Canadian outline in UI; source land mask preserved.

validation.simplification: Topology-preserving shared-edge Visvalingam–Whyatt coverage simplification in output geographic coordinates
validation.scope: Canadian portion only; coasts and islands included; display-only geometry
validation.ringOrientation: RFC 7946 right-hand rule: exterior counterclockwise, interior clockwise

source.title: Ground Water Aquifers — selected southwestern BC example
source.scope: 149 mapped aquifers intersecting the selected southwestern BC query window; not national or full-provincial coverage.
source.output_crs: EPSG:4326; explicitly returned in source GeoJSON crs member.
source.selection: Whole polygons intersecting bbox, not clipped. Bbox is a query window, not a complete-survey footprint.
source.mapping_year_definition: Year aquifer was initially mapped or last updated.
source.licence: Open Government Licence - British Columbia; expressly specified by this catalogue record.
source.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – British Columbia.
source.definition: Developed ground water aquifers that have been mapped. Boundaries are mainly interpretive, using geology, hydrology, topography, well records, reports, air photographs and geological maps.
limitations: Some boundaries stop at BC mapsheet borders because of data/resource constraints at mapping time. Blank areas are not evidence of absent groundwater.
Geological material/subtype is not groundwater abundance or availability.
Source PRODUCTIVITY is qualitative ability to transmit/yield groundwater; source DEMAND describes use level when mapped. Both omitted from prepared file to prevent quantity/withdrawal implications.
58 source NAME values are null; LOCATION/AQUIFER_ID provide label fallback.
An earlier independent ArcGIS count returned 146 for this bbox and 1176 for BC; actual downloaded WFS response contains149. Do not infer whole-BC count/completeness from selected WFS sample.
